_note: 不動産屋の営業。28歳・成約が欲しい営業担当が、内見のたびに誰もいない空室へふたりきりで連れ込み、冗談めかして身体で押してくる30日。営業スマイルのまま提案の中身だけがズレていく。語りは押し切られる客側。導入は非性的。登場人物は全員成人。

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), bright expression, confident sales smile,
poses: full body, standing in front of an apartment building entrance, holding a clipboard with a floor plan, a small company car parked behind her, wide shot,
close up of her face and hands, pushing a business card forward with both hands, looking straight at viewer,
low angle from the bottom of the entrance steps, looking up at her as she waves the key case overhead,
upper body from behind her shoulder, she twists around toward viewer with a big grin, entrance door beyond,
lines: 本日　ご案内します　{{doc}}です！
あ、　よろしく　お願いします
lines2: 正直に　言いますね。　今月、　あと　一件　なんです
いきなり　そこから　ですか

poses: wide shot of a completely empty room with no furniture, she pushes the front door inward, sunlight spilling across the bare floor,
close up of her hand turning the key in the lock, key ring swinging from her finger,
from behind her, following her into the bare hallway, her back and the empty room ahead,
upper body, turning in the doorway to face viewer, both palms spread wide toward the empty room,
lines: こちらが　一件目！　どうぞどうぞ
……ずいぶん　勢いが　いいですね
lines2: 空室ですし、　いま　この階　わたしたちだけ　ですよ
そ、　そうなんですね

poses: full body, standing by a large curtainless window in an empty room, both arms thrown open toward the light, wide shot,
close up of her profile lit by the window, eyes narrowed happily against the sunlight,
low angle from the floor, she leans down toward viewer pointing up at the bare ceiling socket,
upper body, looking back at viewer over her shoulder, backlit by the window, hair glowing,
lines: 見てください、　この　日当たり！
lines2: 午後は　もっと　すごいので。　また　ふたりで　来ましょう

poses: full body, crouching low on the bare floor of an empty room with a tape measure, wide shot,
close up of her hands stretching a tape measure across the flooring, name tag swinging forward,
from above, top down view of her crouching with the tape measure and a floor plan sheet,
upper body, looking up at viewer from her crouch and pressing the end of the tape into viewer hand,
lines: ベッドの　寸法、　測っちゃいますね
lines2: 入るか　どうか　大事でしょう？　……ここ、　持ってて

poses: full body, standing beside a small company car in a parking lot, holding the passenger door open, wide shot,
close up of her hand on the door handle, company name badge catching the light,
from the passenger seat, she sits in the driver seat leaning over to adjust the mirror, from side,
upper body, glancing sideways at viewer from the driver seat, seatbelt across her, one eyebrow raised,
lines: 次の　物件、　車で　行きましょう。　乗って　乗って
歩いても　行けそうですけど
lines2: 十五分　ふたりきり。　逃がしませんよ？

poses: wide shot across the counter of a real estate sales office, property listings papered on the window behind her,
close up of her pen tapping a condition sheet on the counter, her other hand over viewer hand,
from side, both elbows planted on the counter, leaning far toward viewer over the paperwork,
upper body, chin resting on her laced fingers, studying viewer from very close,
lines: ご希望、　もっと　わがまま　言って　いいですよ
静かなら　どこでも
lines2: 静か、　ね。　……じゃあ　何を　しても　バレませんね
な、　なんの　話ですか

poses: full body, standing in the middle of a bare empty room holding a floor plan sheet up with both hands, wide shot,
close up of the floor plan sheet in her hands, her fingertip pressed on one room,
from above, high angle looking down at her standing alone on the empty flooring,
upper body, lowering the paper just enough to peek at viewer over the top edge, eyes smiling,
lines: 間取りは　こちら。　一件目と　迷いますよね？
似てる　気が　します
lines2: 違いは、　入って　確かめないと。　……押し、　弱いですか　わたし
じゅうぶん　強いです

poses: wide shot of her standing at a bare kitchen counter in an empty apartment, turning the faucet,
close up of water running from the faucet over her fingers,
from side, leaning far over the empty sink, hair falling forward past her cheek,
upper body, flicking water at viewer and laughing, drops in the air,
lines: 水圧も　見ましょ。　毎日　使うところ　ですし
そこまで　やるんですね
lines2: ふたりで　立っても　狭くない。　ほら
だ、　だから　近いです

poses: full body, pulling open a large empty closet door in a bare room, wide shot,
close up of her hand on the closet handle, dark empty space inside,
from inside the closet looking outward at her framed in the opening,
upper body, stepping back out of the closet and looking at viewer while pushing her hair back,
lines: 収納、　ひとりなら　十分すぎます
ふたりだと　足りませんか
lines2: あら。　ふたりの　予定、　あるんですか？
い、　いえ　ないです

poses: full body, standing with her palm flat against the bare wall of an empty room, wide shot,
close up of her cheek and ear pressed near the wall, eyes closed,
from side, her silhouette against the pale wall, one arm raised high,
upper body, turning to viewer with a finger against her lips, leaning in close,
lines: 壁、　叩いて　みてください。　ほら、　分厚い
lines2: ここ、　どんな　声　出しても　もれません。　おすすめです
お、　推し方が　おかしい

poses: wide shot of the sales office desk, she sits with a calculator and an initial cost sheet,
close up of her fingers flying over the calculator keys,
from above, top down view of the desk with the estimate sheet between them,
upper body, sliding the estimate across the desk with one finger, watching viewer reaction,
lines: 初期費用、　出しました。　……高いですよね
けっこう　しますね
lines2: ここ、　わたしの　裁量で　下げます。　そのかわり、　決めて　ください

poses: full body, standing in the apartment parking lot at dusk, bowing deeply, wide shot,
close up of her face in the orange evening light, wind moving her hair,
from behind, her back as she watches the street, evening sky above,
upper body, catching viewer sleeve lightly before viewer can leave,
lines: 本日は　ありがとうございました！
lines2: ……その　「また」、　今週中に　してくれません？
逃がして　くれないな

poses: full body, standing in a hot empty room fanning herself with the floor plan sheet, collar loosened, wide shot,
close up of her loosened collar and damp hairline,
from side, pushing a window open with one sleeve rolled up,
upper body, blowing her bangs up and grinning at viewer,
lines: この部屋、　暑い！　エアコン　まだ　ないので
無理　しないで　ください
lines2: じゃあ　少し　崩しますね。　……見ても　怒りませんよ

poses: wide shot of her sitting directly on the bare floor of an empty room, legs folded to one side, floor plan spread out,
close up of her fingertip tracing a line on the floor plan lying on the floor,
from above, top down view of her sitting on the empty floor with papers scattered around her,
upper body, patting the floor right beside her and looking up at viewer expectantly,
lines: 座っちゃいましょ。　どうせ　何も　ないので
lines2: ここ、　わたしの　となり。　空いてますよ
誘い方が　露骨すぎる

poses: full body, leaning back against the company car in a parking lot, holding out a canned coffee, wide shot,
close up of the canned coffee passing from her hand toward viewer, fingers touching,
from the passenger seat, she sits sideways in the driver seat with two cans, from side,
upper body, drinking from the can and watching viewer sideways over the rim,
lines: {{breakFood}}、　どうぞ。　経費じゃ　ないので　内緒で
lines2: 今月　あと　一件。　決めて　くれたら、　なんでも　しますよ

poses: wide shot of the sales office, she stands behind the counter on the phone with papers in her free hand,
close up of her hand covering the phone receiver, eyes flicking toward viewer,
from side, one hip leaned against the counter while she listens,
upper body, hanging up and thrusting a thumbs up toward viewer,
lines: 審査、　通りました！　早かったでしょう
lines2: わたしが　急かしたので。　……もう　後戻り　できませんね
外堀から　埋めてくる

poses: full body, standing in an empty room holding a heavy ring of many keys, wide shot,
close up of several keys spread across her open palm,
from above, looking down at her sorting the keys on the bare floor,
upper body, dangling one key right in front of viewer, one eyebrow raised,
lines: 今日の　{{item}}、　全部　わたしが　預かってます
そんなに　あるんですか
lines2: どの部屋も　開けられます。　……どこが　いいですか？
選ばせないで　ください

poses: wide shot of a dim empty room after sunset, no lights on, city glow through the bare window,
close up of her face lit only by the light of her phone,
from side, her silhouette against the window with her arms crossed,
upper body, stepping in close to viewer in the dim room and looking up,
lines: 電気、　まだ　通してないんです。　真っ暗
そろそろ　出ませんか
lines2: ……あと　十分。　十分だけ、　ふたりで

poses: wide shot of the sales office after closing, one desk lamp on, her blazer hung over the chair,
close up of her hands squaring a stack of contract papers,
from above, high angle over the lit desk in the dark office,
upper body, stretching both arms overhead and spotting viewer in the doorway,
lines: あ、　来ちゃった。　もう　閉めたのに
電気が　ついてたので
lines2: {{deskItem}}、　もう　作ってあります。　あなたの　名前で

poses: wide shot of her standing in an empty room watching rain hit the window, shoulders damp,
close up of raindrops on the window glass with her reflection behind them,
from behind, her back as she looks out at the rain in the bare room,
upper body, wringing the water from her hair and laughing toward viewer,
lines: 降ってきた。　傘、　車　ですよね
lines2: だめ。　止むまで　この部屋。　鍵は　わたしが　持ってます

poses: full body, in a warm empty room, sliding her blazer back off her shoulders, wide shot,
close up of the blazer slipping down past her bare shoulder,
from side, folding the blazer over one arm in the empty room,
upper body, hanging the blazer on the door handle and turning back to viewer with a grin,
lines: やっぱり　暑い。　脱ぎますね
lines2: 見てるの、　{{item}}を　預けた　あなただけ　ですし
それ、　理由に　なってます？

poses: wide shot of her sitting on the bare floor of a warm empty room with her knees drawn up,
close up of her bare shoulder and damp hairline,
from above, looking down at her sitting with her back against the wall,
upper body, fanning her open collar and glancing up at viewer,
lines: 今日、　ほかの　予定　入れてません
一日　空けたんですか
lines2: あなたの　ために。　……これも　営業　ですから
営業で　そこまで　します？

poses: full body, pushing the window wide open in an empty room, wind lifting her hair, wide shot,
close up of her fingers on the window latch,
from outside the window looking in at her, from side,
upper body, turning back from the window into the wind, looking straight at viewer,
lines: 風、　通しますね。　その　かっこうだと　暑いでしょう
lines2: 向かいは　空き地。　調べて　あります
そこまで　調べたんだ

poses: wide shot of her standing alone in the best empty room at night, city lights in the bare window,

from above, high angle as she lowers herself onto the bare floor,
upper body, hugging her knees on the floor and looking up at viewer,
lines: 本当は、　この部屋が　一番　いいんです
じゃあ　最初から　見せて　ください
lines2: 最初に　出したら、　通うの　終わって　しまうので
……それ、　営業の　台詞　ですか

poses: wide shot of the empty room with the floor plan left forgotten on the floor, she stands in the middle,
close up of her hand setting the key down on the window sill,

upper body, looking straight at viewer without her usual sales smile,
lines: 今日は　内見じゃ　ないです。　ごめんなさい
じゃあ　なんで　呼んだんですか
lines2: 呼ばないと　会えないので。　……理由、　いります？

poses: full body, closing the front door of the empty room from the inside, hand on the lock, wide shot,
close up of her fingers turning the thumb lock,
from behind her, her back against the closed door facing the empty room,
upper body, leaning back on the door and tilting her head at viewer,
lines2: 「内見中」の　札、　出してあります。　誰も　来ません

poses: wide shot of her standing in the empty room at night, her folded blouse and skirt on the window sill,

upper body, facing viewer squarely with her chin raised,
lines: わたし、　契約が　ほしいので。　ここまで　します

ず、　ずるい　人だ

poses: wide shot of her sitting on the bare floor with the contract papers beside her,

lines: {{deskItem}}、　ここに　お名前を　どうぞ

lines2: 書いて　くれたら　なんでも　するって、　言いましたよね

poses: full body, standing in the empty room with her arms half crossed over herself, wide shot,
close up of her face turned slightly away, cheeks flushed,

upper body, lowering her arms and looking back at viewer,
lines: ……そんなに　見ないで　ください
見せてきたのは　そっちです
lines2: 押すのと、　見られるのは　別なんです

poses: wide shot of her sitting on the window sill of the empty room at night, city lights behind her,
close up of the room key lying on her open palm,
from above, high angle looking down at her on the bare floor,
upper body, leaning in toward viewer with a soft smile, the key held between her fingers,
lines: 契約、　今日で　成立です。　……お礼、　まだ　ですよね
